description: Locked generation camera and composition contract for square Haven island assets.
generationRules: Use the approved Mossprout square-v2 master as the structural camera reference for every new island.
Keep the entire island, connection sockets, and underside visible with even transparent padding.
Keep all verticals vertical, all opposing construction edges parallel, and the rear and front widths equal.
Render residents, order trays, merge items, UI, and long connecting bridges separately.
Preserve the cozy matte 3D toy-diorama material language and low texture detail.
